newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks 50,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks 50,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Friday he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of American soft red or soft white wheat for loading from November 18 to 30.
Egypt had tendered earlier this week for 50,000 tonnes of Australian soft white wheat or French soft red wheat.
Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters that he had was seeking American bids for that tender as well.
Shanakiri said the deadline for the American bids was 0600 gmt on Saturday. The tender would be decided on later in the same day, he added.
"Now we want offers from those three sources," he said.
Earlier, Shakankiri said he would consider buying American wheat if the price was right.
